name: Spectrum (Chebyshev feature forecasting)
plain: Fits a Chebyshev-basis ridge regression through past outputs or features over time, and predicts them on cached steps, blended with a first-order extrapolation. Real steps get sparser as a flexible window grows. Implementations disagree on what is forecast: whole denoised output, or the feature just before the final layer.
math:
Φ_ik = T_k(x_i), x∈[−1,1]; C = (ΦᵀΦ + λI)⁻¹ΦᵀY.
ŷ = w·(Tᵀ(x)C) + (1−w)·(y_last + k(y_last−y_prev)), k=(t−t_last)/(t_last−t_prev).
Real step if cache<2, step<warmup, or (cached+1)%floor(W)==0; W += flex each real step. Fixed: step%window==0.
benjiyaya: Y = model's denoised output across the whole wrapper, flattened per branch.
sorryhyun: Y = pre-final_layer feature captured by a pre-hook; replays final layer; optional SEA refresh: real if accumulated SEA distance ≥ δ with auto-δ calibration; tail steps always real.

props.hook: set_model_unet_function_wrapper; final_layer forward pre-hook (sorryhyun); forward_orig reassign (evrardt); DIFFUSION_MODEL etc. wrappers (Gavr728); forward hook on last block (Gavr728, Rkkss)
props.architectures: benjiyaya: claims any MODEL, wraps denoised output. sorryhyun: Anima and MOSS DiT. evrardt: Flux double/single blocks. Gavr728: LTXV/LTXAV. Nif00: Anima. Rkkss: MOSS-Image. Singularity: MiniMax H3. ruwwww: SDXL. lieding: mixed; SDXL, Flux, SD3, Hunyuan, Wan pipelines plus a Comfy wrapper.
